scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Athens, 2012. The financial crisis has left Greece in turmoil. Banks are failing, trust in institutions has collapsed. Amidst the chaos, a signal emerges from the noise — a whitepaper describing something called 'Bitcoin'.

scenes.speaker: SAfA
scenes.text: I found something incredible. A peer-to-peer electronic cash system — no banks, no middlemen. It uses cryptographic proof instead of trust. This could change everything.

choices.text: Set up a mining rig immediately

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You dive deep into the whitepaper. SHA-256 hash functions, Merkle trees, proof-of-work — each concept clicks into place like pieces of a puzzle. The mathematics is elegant. The implications are revolutionary.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: You scavenge parts from the electronics market in Monastiraki and assemble a rudimentary mining rig in your apartment. The fans whir, the GPU heats up, and blocks start flowing. You're mining your first cryptocurrency.

scenes.speaker: SAfA
scenes.text: The 2013 bull run — I made a small fortune. It felt like validation, like the revolution was already here. I invested everything in new altcoins and exchanges... including Mt. Gox.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Then it happened. Mt. Gox collapsed. 850,000 Bitcoin vanished. Your savings — gone. The lesson was brutal but clear: decentralisation means nothing without security.

choices.text: We need to build better defences
I need allies — I can't do this alone

scenes.speaker: SAfA
scenes.text: Security first. I started studying every exploit, every vulnerability. But I soon realised — the fight must be waged on both software AND hardware fronts. I needed my old friend.

scenes.speaker: SAfA
scenes.text: I couldn't rebuild alone. I reached out to someone I trusted — Nato Saka, a hardware genius. Together, we could secure both the code and the machines running it.

scenes.speaker: Nato
scenes.text: SAfA, you idealistic fool. But you're right — if we don't protect these networks, nobody will. I've got a warehouse in Piraeus. Solar panels, cooling rigs, the works. Let's build something they can't break.

choices.text: First, we need a plan of attack

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: And so it began. In a hidden workshop beneath a forgotten library in Athens, two friends laid the foundations of something much bigger than either of them imagined. The Crypto Hunters were about to be born.

scenes.speaker: system
scenes.text: Chapter 1 Complete! You've witnessed the spark that ignited the Crypto Hunters. The team is about to grow...
